title: Refund claims for a delayed project - success rate and timelines
p1:
A delayed project does not always mean a lost refund.

Many people assume that once a deadline is missed, getting money back is nearly impossible. But the real outcome often depends on the contract, the reason for the delay, and the evidence you can provide.
p2:
The surprising part: refund claims are often won or lost before the claim is even submitted. Clear agreements, payment records, project updates, and proof of missed commitments can significantly improve your chances.

Success rates vary widely because every project has different terms. Some claims are resolved within weeks, while others can take several months if negotiations or formal reviews are needed.
p3:
The practical lesson is simple: do not wait until the project completely fails. Track delays early, communicate in writing, and understand your refund options while there is still time to act.

A small amount of documentation today can make a major difference later.
